text: The Civic Appointments Committee must select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the Toronto Zoo Board. The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend five candidates to City Council for appointment.

The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview at its next meeting for appointment to the Toronto Zoo Board: TZB2-48 TZB2-83 TZB2-93 TZB2-100 TZB2-102 TZB2-111 TZB2-113 TZB2-122 TZB2-129 TZB2-133 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (June 9, 2021) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Zoo Board.
